dedupe_keys.name: dtdl based realestatecore ontology for smart buildings azure digital twins

description: This repository provides the RealEstateCore domain ontology converted into the Digital Twins Definition Language (DTDL), the modelling language of Azure Digital Twins, delivered by Microsoft in partnership with the RealEstateCore Consortium to give developers a common ontology for smart building solutions and integration between vendors. It is derived from RealEstateCore 3.3 in OWL using Microsoft's OWL2DTDL tool, and is organised around Asset (objects placed in a building), LogicalDevice (electronic equipment or software that talks to the twin platform), Capability (sensors, actuators and parameters, the equivalent of Brick points) and Space (from regions and land to buildings, levels and rooms), with further base interfaces, documentation on extending the models, and notes on alignment with Brick, Project Haystack and W3C BOT. Coverage: any building portfolio. Access: free on GitHub (tag v1.0). Licence: MIT (copyright Microsoft Corporation). Caveats: tied to DTDL and Azure Digital Twins tooling; the OWL original is maintained separately by the consortium. Simulation uses: structuring building twins so that sensor data, spaces and equipment can feed simulation and control applications. Related records: RealEstateCore, Azure Digital Twins, Brick and BOT.
